title: recorder open source [15.04 UPDATED !!]
features:
warning: this script can be detected !!!

open source:
https://github.com/ovoch228/shitty-x/tree/main/rtd

// features //
- auto equip loadout
- auto select maps & modifiers
- auto unit managment in game
- auto play again
- and etc

how to use: 
once in-game, run the recorder and click button 'write file' only during the difficulty selection screen, not after
exit to lobby when you see 'macro recorded' in logs. then find shitty-x folder, in the exploit workspace folder and find ur recordered file, use it in the lobby, after teleporting into the map, use it in game.

// updates //
["31.01.26"] - added Modifiers, added loadout function, fixed a tower placement failure bug i think
["05.02.26"] - improved round end handling, slight optimization
["15.04.26"] - fixed place tower

// if you find any bugs or want to improve the script, please let me know. i'd be very grateful!! //
